content.name: Hellish Rebuke

time.condition: which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see

entries: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes {@damage 2d10} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

content.name: Hellish Rebuke

time.condition: which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

entries: The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 1.
